messages:
Anya: RFC follow-up: propose a clear midflight ownership handoff state in the edge proxy to avoid ambiguous retries. Plan: add HANDOFF -> REHYDRATE -> ACTIVE states and a signed HandoffToken (attempt_id + small prefix blob).

Kai: Nice. How do we keep idempotency across owners?

Anya: Bind a stable idempotency_key + handoff_attempt. Any execution with handoff_attempt <= last_committed_attempt is rejected. If upstream can't dedupe we return an error rather than risk double-exec.

Ben: What about partial responses mid-handoff? Resume or cut?

Anya: Support transparent resume for clients that advertise resume capability via handshake header. Otherwise conservative cut with trailer `x-resume-token` + `grpc-status: TRANSFER_REQUIRED`.

Marta: Observability: emit spans handoff_prepare, handoff_publish, rehydrate_start/complete and counters handoff_failures, rehydrate_latency_ms, orphaned_duration_ms.

Leah: Ops: make handoff opt-in per-route, start at 0.5% traffic for an internal route, include feature flag and operator kill-switch. Add memory-pressure gate (if mem>80% avoid handoff).

Ben: Snapshot size tradeoff? Eager small snapshot vs lazy rehydrate.

Anya: Default eager snapshot up to 512 tokens in token_count_limit. If above limit emit HANDOFF_TOO_LARGE and refuse transfer. We'll measure network/memory impact and iterate.

ops-bot: incident-bot: note: duplicate replay seen in prod #incidents/3264; this change might mitigate that class.

Kai: Billing question: which owner consumes quota during handoff?

Ben: I vote original owner continues to be billed until handoff_commit to avoid double counting.

Marta: Agreed. Also add metric handoff_commit_latency_ms and per-route histogram for snapshot_kb.

Anya: I'll draft the proto and state diagram and open PR with rollout checklist and tests for dedupe/resume. Will include watchdog to disable handoff if orphan_rate > 0.1% for 10m.

Kai: I'll review the proto.

Leah: POC: enable on one internal streaming route, 0.5% traffic, collect handoff_success, handoff_failures, duplicates, and snapshot_size.

Anya: Thanks all, will post PR link when ready.
